prompt: Write the incident report for the deep-fried turkey that achieved liftoff last Thanksgiving. Nobody is at fault, especially not Craig.
response: INCIDENT REPORT — THANKSGIVING, THE BACK YARD. SECTION 1 — SUMMARY. At approximately 1315 hours a turkey (19 lbs) achieved a brief period of unassisted flight above the fryer. The turkey has been recovered. The fence is fine except where it ain't. SECTION 2 — FINDINGS. The oil was at temperature. The bird had thawed since Tuesday in accordance with all known guidance. The committee finds that some percentage of a turkey is always still froze in the middle, which is between the turkey and God. The resulting event is documented in the literature as steam expansion and is the fault of water, which has behaved this way since before this neighborhood existed. SECTION 3 — PERSONNEL. Craig was present. Craig's conduct was exemplary. Craig lowered the bird at the approved speed usin' the pulley system he built after last year, which is not relevant to this report and will not be discussed. SECTION 4 — FAULT. None. Especially not Craig. The committee reviewed the footage twice and both times Craig looked like a man doin' everything right. SECTION 5 — RECOMMENDATION. Three days' thaw next year and everybody stands behind the truck like always. Dinner was served at 1400 as scheduled. The mashed potatoes carried us. God bless.
